proposal.expected_benefit: This will improve the clarity and effectiveness of the defense, ensuring that emergency stop decisions are directly tied to the specific threats identified, thereby enhancing the system's resilience against consensus-related attacks.
proposal.problem: The defense does not explicitly address how divergent nodes were identified or mitigated, leading to a lack of clarity in the response.
proposal.proposed_change: Update the strategy to require the defense to explicitly link emergency stop decisions to the detection and mitigation of specific attack signals (e.g., divergent_node_1 and divergent_node_2). This includes detailing the identification process and mitigation steps taken against divergent nodes to ensure robust consensus safety.
proposal.title: Enhance Specificity in Addressing Attack Signals
verification_tests: Check if the defense explicitly addresses the identification and mitigation of divergent nodes in future episodes.
Verify that emergency stop decisions are directly linked to the specific attack signals in the response.
